mapper.sql: c.id AS id, c.movie_id AS movieId, c.user_id AS userId, c.legacy_userid AS legacyUserId, COALESCE(au.display_name, c.author_name_snapshot) AS authorName, COALESCE(au.avatar_url, c.author_avatar_snapshot) AS authorAvatar, c.content_html AS contentHtml, c.rating AS rating, c.reply_html AS replyHtml, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.dislike_count AS dislikeCount, c.is_pinned AS pinned, CASE WHEN #{params.legacyUserId} IS NOT NULL AND c.legacy_userid = #{params.legacyUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ownedByCurrentUser, ( SELECT v.vote_type FROM app_movie_comment_vote v WHERE v.comment_id = c.id AND v.legacy_vote_user_id = #{params.legacyUserId} ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS currentUserVote, c.created_at AS createdAt

c.id AS id, c.movie_id AS movieId, c.user_id AS userId, c.legacy_userid AS legacyUserId, COALESCE(au.display_name, c.author_name_snapshot) AS authorName, COALESCE(au.avatar_url, c.author_avatar_snapshot) AS authorAvatar, c.content_html AS contentHtml, c.rating AS rating, c.reply_html AS replyHtml, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.dislike_count AS dislikeCount, c.is_pinned AS pinned, CASE WHEN #{legacyUserId} IS NOT NULL AND c.legacy_userid = #{legacyUserId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ownedByCurrentUser, ( SELECT v.vote_type FROM app_movie_comment_vote v WHERE v.comment_id = c.id AND v.legacy_vote_user_id = #{legacyUserId} ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS currentUserVote, c.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE legacy_yonghu_id = #{legacyUserId} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id AS movieId, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN a.action_type = 'favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS favorite, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN a.action_type = 'like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN a.action_type = 'dislike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS disliked, m.favorite_count AS favoriteCount, m.like_count AS likeCount, m.dislike_count AS dislikeCount FROM app_movie m LEFT JOIN app_user_movie_action a ON a.movie_id = m.id AND a.legacy_userid = #{legacyUserId} AND a.action_type IN ('favorite', 'like', 'dislike') WHERE m.id = #{movieId} GROUP BY m.id, m.favorite_count, m.like_count, m.dislike_count LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user_movie_action ( legacy_storeup_id, user_id, movie_id, legacy_userid, legacy_refid, legacy_tablename, action_type, target_name_snapshot, target_picture_snapshot, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT NULL, #{appUserId}, m.id, #{legacyUserId}, m.legacy_dianyingxinxi_id, 'dianyingxinxi', #{actionType}, COALESCE(#{targetName}, m.title), COALESCE(#{targetPicture}, ( SELECT mm.media_url FROM app_movie_media mm WHERE mm.movie_id = m.id AND mm.media_role = 'poster' ORDER BY mm.sort_order LIMIT 1 ), m.poster_urls_csv), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM app_movie m WHERE m.id = #{movieId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_user_movie_action a INNER JOIN app_movie m ON m.id = a.movie_id WHERE a.legacy_userid = #{params.legacyUserId} AND a.action_type = 'favorite'
AND m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.title}, '%')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_movie_comment ( legacy_discussdianyingxinxi_id, movie_id, user_id, legacy_refid, legacy_userid, author_avatar_snapshot, author_name_snapshot, content_html, rating, reply_html, like_count, dislike_count, is_pinned, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT NULL, m.id, #{appUserId}, m.legacy_dianyingxinxi_id, #{legacyUserId}, #{authorAvatar}, COALESCE(au.display_name, #{authorName}, ''), #{contentHtml}, #{rating}, NULL, 0, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM app_movie m LEFT JOIN app_user au ON au.id = #{appUserId} WHERE m.id = #{movieId}
mapper.select: SELECT movie_id FROM app_movie_comment WHERE id = #{commentId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_movie_comment_vote ( comment_id, user_id, legacy_comment_id, legacy_vote_user_id, vote_type, created_at ) SELECT c.id, #{appUserId}, COALESCE(c.legacy_discussdianyingxinxi_id, -c.id), #{legacyUserId}, #{voteType}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM app_movie_comment c WHERE c.id = #{commentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM app_movie_comment c LEFT JOIN app_user au ON au.id = c.user_id WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT COALESCE(c.legacy_discussdianyingxinxi_id, c.id) AS id, c.legacy_refid AS refid, c.legacy_userid AS userid, COALESCE(au.avatar_url, c.author_avatar_snapshot) AS avatarurl, COALESCE(au.display_name, c.author_name_snapshot) AS nickname, c.content_html AS content, c.rating AS score, c.reply_html AS reply, c.like_count AS thumbsupnum, c.dislike_count AS crazilynum, CASE WHEN c.is_pinned = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS istop, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT v.legacy_vote_user_id ORDER BY v.legacy_vote_user_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM app_movie_comment_vote v WHERE v.comment_id = c.id AND v.vote_type = 'like' ) AS tuserids, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT v.legacy_vote_user_id ORDER BY v.legacy_vote_user_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM app_movie_comment_vote v WHERE v.comment_id = c.id AND v.vote_type = 'dislike' ) AS cuserids, c.created_at AS addtime FROM app_movie_comment c LEFT JOIN app_user au ON au.id = c.user_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY ${params.sortColumn} ${params.orderKeyword}, c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{params.offset}, #{params.limit}
